Thanks for the details and the attachments — those help. We can typically support accelerator cohort top-ups through our self-serve promo workflow, or, for larger cohorts, we can issue a single accelerator promo code that each founder redeems. To confirm eligibility I need:

- A signed cohort acceptance PDF (we have your attachment, thank you)
- A list with company names, contact email per founder, and domain for verification (the cohort list looks close; if you can add individual emails that speeds things up)

A couple logistics: promo codes expire in 90 days by default; if you need a longer window we can set that per-cohort. Also note that trial credits are applied per account and cannot be transferred after redemption.

I'll loop in Sales Ops to start a verification ticket once you confirm the final list.
